selection: Compare selected five-seed macro validation CRPS; improvement must exceed min_delta; ties preserve candidate_order. Median and mean RMSE guards stay relative to epoch zero.
training: Each trajectory runs through its full epoch budget. Epoch10 and epoch20 policies share the exact first ten updates. Battery balance uses example weights N/(B*n_b) on both CE and KL, preserving shuffle and optimizer-step count.
validation: Concatenate validation contexts for efficient batching, split predictions back by battery, score each seed separately, then average metrics equally over seeds and batteries. Single-seed diagnostic uses the same batch layout.
evaluation: Freeze all outer-fold choices before any heldout forecasting. Evaluate all four policies at training seed42, then chosen policies at training seeds43/44; inference seeds42/43/44. No full-data refit.
limitation: Previously inspected four-battery benchmark; exploratory followup, not an independent test set or significance test.
